user_directive: The one thing you HAVE to take into consideration is that this is going to be HD-2D graphics. Try and take that into consideration as we build out the environment assets.

rendering_contract.target: pixel-art sprites in a lit diorama with depth and atmospheric separation
rendering_contract.camera_dependent_extensions: Additional building side/roof/depth surfaces require the actual selected camera and visible-surface need. No blanket isometric conversion.

camera_calibration.note: The flat asset study does not establish these values. Record them from a working scene slice.

not_delivered_as_completed_systems: collision meshes or gameplay depth sorting
playable HD-2D map or engine capture

integration_tasks.task: Assemble one Hearthmoss house, door, path, tree, prop/fence group, NPC, Kith and pond edge in the actual renderer; record camera and world scale.
Check foot/base contact, entry thresholds, depth ordering, visual overhang and base collision; identify required roof/canopy layers.
Check neutral day and dusk/window-light setups with shadows and restrained bloom; identify any required clean emissive masks.
Define water motion/reflection and atmospheric layer treatment in the renderer before commissioning dependent masks or overlays.
Inspect moving sprites and camera motion for atlas bleed, texture shimmer, scale mismatch and excessive depth blur; preserve gameplay focus.
Produce only the side/roof surfaces, terrain banks, continuous ledges, separated occluders and scenery layers that the checked scene actually needs.

approval_effect: Records a visual-production constraint only; no new art approval is inferred.
queue_effect: Does not silently reorder the existing v2.3 UI and character queue; the calibrated scene is a dependency for further camera-dependent environment art.
